title: Duotrope alternatives for tracking your submissions
seoTitle: Duotrope Alternatives: Free Submission Trackers Compared
description: Free and paid Duotrope alternatives compared: The Submission Grinder, Chill Subs, Submittable, a spreadsheet and Missa, by price, statistics and import.
summary: What Duotrope does best, what the free trackers cover, and how to move your submission history without losing any of it.
answer: Free Duotrope alternatives include The Submission Grinder, Chill Subs’ basic tracker, a free Submittable account and a spreadsheet. Missa adds a tracker for calls across writing, art, film and music. Choose by the magazines you send to, the statistics you use and how easily your history moves. Duotrope’s research tools still earn their price if you use them.
keyPoints: Duotrope costs US$6 a month or US$60 a year; pay for it if you use its research.
The Submission Grinder is free and donation-based; Chill Subs and Submittable have free trackers too.
Before you move your history, import a few hard records first and keep the original file.
illustrationAlt: Illustration of submission records moving from a spreadsheet into a tracker in three steps: export a copy, check records, keep a backup.
